LanguageData.WotF_EntropyCirclet.description: A slender metal circlet forged from elven steel, mithril, or adamantine and set with jade. It channels unruly psychic turbulence away from the brow, speeding neural heat recovery while raising the wearer's neural heat limit.
LanguageData.WotF_EntropyCirclet.label: entropy circlet
LanguageData.WotF_TerrainStride.description: Unique magic has been woven into this light cloak, allowing its wearer to glide effortlessly over obstacles without breaking stride.\nLegend has it the elves devised it to move freely through dense woodland undergrowth.
LanguageData.WotF_TerrainStride.label: strider cloak
